packets.instruction:
Create the board-local hook that owns the STATE-TO-URL direction. It takes the current BoardFilters and the current search object. It calls useNavigate() from @tanstack/react-router. In an effect: compute the desired facet params via toBoardFilterSearchParams(filters); compare against the facets already in search using areBoardFiltersEqual(parseBoardFilterSearch(search), filters); if equal, DO NOT navigate (this is the no-loop guard).
